name: Should I use a first-time home buyer program or a traditional mortgage?

mainEntity.name: Should I use a first-time home buyer program or a traditional mortgage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between a first-time home buyer program and a traditional mortgage depends on your financial situation and long-term goals. Assistance programs often offer lower down payments, reduced interest rates, or closing cost help, but may come with specific income limits or property restrictions. Traditional mortgages might offer more flexibility but require a larger down payment. A key decision factor is assessing your immediate cash availability versus your desire for more flexible property choices or fewer restrictions. Our agents can help you compare options suitable for your needs in South Florida.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose based on your financial situation; assistance programs offer benefits but may have restrictions, while traditional mortgages offer flexibility.
